hero.title: The Satavahanas: Deccan Powerhouse
hero.description: The Satavahanas bridged the north and south, establishing the first major imperial power in the Deccan after the Mauryas.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: The Satavahana chronology remains debated, but generally spans from the late Mauryan decline to the rise of the Abhiras.

cards.details: Simuka, the founder, overthrew the Kanva dynasty to establish Satavahana rule.
Reign of Gautamiputra Satakarni, the restorer of Satavahana glory after defeating Nahapana.
Decline of the main dynasty, leading to the rise of splinter powers like the Vakatakas and Ikshvakus.

items.title: G.S.Y.H.S
items.decryption: Key rulers in order/importance. Remember: Simuka (Founder), Hala (Gathasaptashati), Gautamiputra (Restorer).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing 'Matronymics' with Matriarchy; Satavahanas were patriarchal but respected queens.
Assuming they were purely agrarian; they were masters of maritime trade via western ports.
Mistaking 'Gathasaptashati' for a religious text; it is secular Prakrit literature.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Pratisthana (Paithan)
  • Controlled Godavari-Krishna valleys
  • Gateways: Bharukachha (Broach), Sopara

Personalities

  • Simuka: Founder
  • Gautamiputra Satakarni: 'Ekabrahmana'
  • Hala: Author of Gathasaptashati
  • Administration
    • Land grants (Brahmadeya) leading to feudalism
    • 'Amatyas' (ministers) and 'Mahamatras'
  • Socio-Economic
    • Rise of Guilds (Srenis)
    • Prakrit as the court language
    • Trade with Romans (Gold coins)
  • Art & Architecture
    • Karle Chaitya
    • Amaravati School of Art
